explication: Maroto is a Go library for constructing PDFs with a Bootstrap-like row/column layout. The principal workflow is to configure a document, compose pages from rows, columns, and components, then generate and save a PDF. The graph also preserves documented page management and header/footer behavior, plus the rendering backend, code generation, caching, and metrics/reporting capabilities. Some branches are documented or indexed but their implementation was not excerpted, so those links are dashed where the connection is unverified.
